name: Bone Loom

do.objective: The iron key is on the cutting table at the north end
The iron key: the locked door is at the east end of the north lane

intro.title: BONE LOOM
lines: Nine crossings under a roof of rails, and a cradle hung over every one.
The doors breathe on the beat. The way to the key is three of them.

outro: The iron key turned and the door at the end of the north lane let go. The cradles above the crossings were all empty by then. Beyond the door a rail leads out, and it is warm.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A loom the size of a church, and nobody at it. Every crossing in the hall has two cradles on rails over it, and the people in them are not awake.

messages.speaker: PLATE
messages.text: A thread, one voice to a cradle, cut to a length and laid in the weave. The plate counts the cradles in a night: four hundred and six. The Quiet One was right about the loom.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The floor of this corridor runs west for ten seconds and stands for eight. When the chevrons turn amber it is about to change.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: These doors breathe. Each is open three seconds in six, and each opens a second after the one in front. Go when the first opens and you are through all three.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The shuttle comes down on this corridor once a bar. Its shadow comes first, and the floor glows orange before it lands.

messages.speaker: PLATE
messages.text: CUTTING ROOM. The length of a thread is the length of a life: it is measured here and cut. The tally on the table is not finished.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The iron key lies on the cutting table, under the lamps. It opens the door at the east end of the north lane.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The door is shut. It takes an iron key, and the key is in the cutting room at the north end of the hall.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The pale ones are woven, not grafted: they come out of the cradles already walking. Somebody has been spinning them all night.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The north wall of this corridor rings hollow in one place. The weave is thinner there.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: I hid these under the frame the night they began the new loom. If you are reading this the old one has stopped.

objective: Cross the hall to the north: the iron key is in the cutting room behind three breathing doors. The locked door is at the east end of the north lane

quality.introduces: timing at scale: breathing doors on the beat, two conveyors and a shuttle, and the woven that come out of the cradles
